(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos, wherein said non-destructive medium consists of water.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with a cell wall degrading enzyme selected from the group consisting of gentle sonication and VISCOZYME@.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos selected from the group consisting of corn embryos. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) in a quiescent state until the outcome of the genetic analysis is determined.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping performed by polymerase chain reaction (PCR) analysis.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The method of claim 1 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on their analyzed genotype.

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is at least semi-automated.
